top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 76 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: A House check of every sitting member found one missing CY2025 annual report past every extension.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed for an extension on 6/4/2026. His final extension date was 8/13/2026, and no CY2025 annual financial disclosure is on file 76 days later, according to the Deadline Watch check against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD.

The check is partial. The Senate annual-report check and the Senate extensions check both failed with a parsing error. A filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can also read as missing, so the result rests on the House index search alone.

Separately, the Ethics Agreement Tracker lists 7 confirmed officials with no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance, the longest of them Michelle White Bowman, Governor and Vice Chairman for Supervision of the Federal Reserve System Board of Governors, 421 days past her 9/2/2025 due date.

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: One logged contact with the U.N. ambassador; the Vice President is named as lobbied in one LDA filing
paragraphs: A Tibet-related foreign agent's supplemental statement logs a call-type contact with the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations. The scanned contact log is interleaved, so only the fragments below are reported. A second FARA filing mentions President Donald Trump but logs no contact, and it was set aside.

items: Mike Waltz, U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations: the contact log in the supplemental statement of Office of Tibet (registrant #1699) has an entry dated 08/24/2026 naming Ambassador Waltz and his U.N. team, with method listed as call. The purpose text reads "Briefed Ambassador Waltz and ... the UN team on the ongoing" and is cut off in the OCR. Nearby fragments mention Ted Budd, the Tibetan community and the Dalai Lama. Filing.

LDA: Motor & Equipment Manufacturers Association (self-filed, 3rd Quarter amendment) lists the Vice President among the entities lobbied. Topics include counterfeit automotive parts, vehicle technology and consumer access to vehicle data. Filing.

sections.headline: Two Appointees File Ethics Compliance Certifications
paragraphs: Two Senate-confirmed presidential appointees filed certifications with the Office of Government Ethics confirming their compliance with required ethics agreements.

items: Charlton L. Allen, General Counsel, Federal Labor Relations Authority — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. The certification confirms his completion of required resignations from the Law Offices of Charlton L. Allen, PLLC, Liberty Strategies, LLC, and the Madison Center for Law & Liberty, Inc.
Barbera Hale Thornhill, Director of the Office to Monitor and Combat Trafficking with the rank of Ambassador at Large, Department of State — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance.

sections.headline: One foreign client dropped, and eight filings from existing registrants
paragraphs: No new registrants appeared in this window. One registrant dropped a Russian principal, and eight filings are new.

items: Vermillion Advisors LLC (#7338) no longer represents Eduard Khudainatov (Russia), as of 10/26/2026. Notice. The firm also filed a supplemental statement stamped 10/26/2026: Filing.

blocks.text: Informational materials: Representative of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (#2619; principal the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, Cyprus) filed three sets, stamped 10/26 and 10/27: one, two, three. DCI Group AZ, LLC (#6278; principal Republic of Srpska, Bosnia & Herzegovina) filed materials stamped 10/27 that quote Bosnian Serb leader Cvijanovic on President Donald Trump; no contact is logged. Supplemental statements: Zeno Group, Inc. (#6652) filing; Mintz, Levin, Cohn, Ferris, Glovsky and Popeo, P.C. (#7722) filing; Frank Adrien Laws (#7465) filing.

sections.headline: A single House filing, a candidate report
paragraphs: One new disclosure was filed, and it is not a stock-trade report. Senate eFD could not be read in this run, so no Senate filings are covered.

sections.headline: Five new registrations, led by a defense lobbying firm's new clients
paragraphs: 168 filings were posted since 10/27: 129 third-quarter reports, 15 third-quarter no-activity reports, 9 third-quarter amendments, 5 registrations, 4 second-quarter amendments, 2 fourth-quarter reports, 1 termination, 1 second-quarter report, 1 registration amendment and 1 first-quarter amendment. About 158 activity reports are left out, including most of the 52 flagged with a signal. Revere Federal Strategies registered two new defense clients and ended another, with former House Armed Services Committee staff member Eric Snelgrove listed on all three.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

The OGE known gaps were not included in this run's input. Contact-log text in FARA filings is OCR and can be interleaved.
